## Overview

In the script `02b-1-pssm-cohorts.R`, survey cohorts from TRD, APPSO, BGS, and DACSO are standardized and consolidated into a unified `t_cohorts_recoded` table for downstream modelling. Across cohorts, the script applies model-year weights, derives age and age-group fields, recodes institution and credential mappings where needed, and constructs harmonized labour-supply and cohort keys (including LCIP4/LCIP2 credential groupings). 

## Role in the Project Pipeline

The PSSM projection chain is a four-term conditional-probability decomposition:

    OCCSN(NOC) = GRADUATES(cred, age)              ← Module 04
               × P(CIP | cred, age)                ← Module 06 (cohort_program_distributions)
               × P(in labour supply | CIP)         ← Module 02b-2 (this script)
               × P(NOC | CIP, region)              ← Module 02b-3 (occupation_distributions)

This script computes **Term 3 — P(in labour supply | CIP)**: the probability that a graduate in a given field of study actually enters BC's workforce as *new labour supply*, rather than continuing in education or not working.

The quantity it produces is the `New_Labour_Supply` column in `labour_supply_distribution` — a weighted proportion, stratified by 4-digit CIP × credential (`LCIP4_CRED`), age rollup, and region. The numerator is survey respondents classified as active new labour supply (NLS codes 1 = in workforce, 2 = studying and working, 3 = derived); the denominator is the full weighted cohort in the same stratum.

Term 3 is built only from survey respondents (`t_cohorts_recoded`: BGS, DACSO, APPSO, TRD). GRAD graduates are not surveyed, so they never appear in this table. Rather, their labour-supply probability is estimated by proxy; Module 07 joins them to the survey-derived `New_Labour_Supply` of the matching credential/CIP group. This is the structural reason the model separates "how many graduated" (admin data, includes GRAD) from "of those, how many entered the workforce" (survey data, excludes GRAD).

Year, institution, region, and response-rate weights correct for non-response and for variation across survey cycles, so the shares reflect the current graduate cohort rather than raw survey counts.

## Methodology Overview

### Survey Compatibility

The routine executes four major functions to ensure survey compatibility between all four surveys.

1. The script filters the central weight table for the 2022-2023 model year and joins it to each survey stream. This ensures that every respondent's contribution is scaled appropriately for provincial labor market representation.

2. While each survey asks about employment differently, this script translates those unique responses into a standardized NEW_LABOUR_SUPPLY variable.
- TRD/APPSO: Based on LABR_EMPLOYED and LABR_IN_LABOUR_MARKET status.
- BGS/DACSO: Uses complex CASE logic involving CURRENT_ACTIVITY (e.g., working vs. seeking vs. further study).

3. The script generates composite keys LCIP4_CRED and LCIP2_CRED. These keys concatenate graduation status, CIP codes, training markers, and credential types into a single string to allow for precise matching against labor market demand.

4. The script manages a "Master Cohort" table (t_cohorts_recoded). It appends new records for TRD and APPSO while performing a "delete-and-replace" refresh for BGS and DACSO to ensure the longitudinal dataset remains current without duplication. 

## Key Output Tables

### t_cohorts_recoded

<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>PEN (Number): The Personal Education Number, a unique identifier for students in the BC education system.</li>
  <li>STQU_ID (String): A unique survey identifier prepended with the survey type (e.g., "BGS - 12345").</li>
  <li>SURVEY (String): A character code representing the specific survey source (e.g., "BGS", "DACSO", "TRD", "APPSO").</li>
  <li>SURVEY_YEAR (Number): The calendar year in which the survey data was collected.</li>
  <li>INST_CD (String): A character code representing the post-secondary institution.</li>
  <li>LCIP_CD (String): The 2-digit Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) family identifier.</li>
  <li>LCP4_CD (String): The 4-digit CIP code identifier for the specific program.</li>
  <li>TTRAIN (Number): A numeric marker indicating if technical training was part of the program.</li>
  <li>NOC_CD (String): The 5-digit National Occupational Classification code representing the graduate's employment.</li>
  <li>AGE_AT_SURVEY (Number): The age of the respondent at the time of the survey.</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP (Number): A numeric binning code representing the student's age cohort.</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP (Number): A higher-level numeric code used to aggregate age groups for broader analysis.</li>
  <li>GRAD_STATUS (String): A code indicating whether the student graduated or completed their program.</li>
  <li>RESPONDENT (Number): A binary flag indicating if the student successfully completed the survey.</li>
  <li>NEW_LABOUR_SUPPLY (Number): A derived indicator representing the student's entry or status in the labor market.</li>
  <li>WEIGHT (Number): The statistical weight applied to the record to ensure provincial representativeness.</li>
  <li>PSSM_CREDENTIAL (String): The standardized credential name (e.g., "BACH" for Bachelor's degree).</li>
  <li>PSSM_CRED (String): A composite field combining graduation status and credential type.</li>
  <li>LCIP4_CRED (String): A high-resolution composite key combining CIP code, training markers, and credential.</li>
  <li>LCIP2_CRED (String): A mid-resolution composite key using the 2-digit CIP family and credential.</li>
  <li>CURRENT_REGION_PSSM_CODE (Number): The standardized regional code where the respondent currently resides.</li>
  <li>AGE_AT_GRAD (Number): A placeholder for the student's age at the time of graduation.</li>
  <li>AGE_GRAD_GROUP (Number): A placeholder for the age cohort grouping at the time of graduation.</li>
  <li>AGE_GRAD_GROUP_ROLLUP (Number): A placeholder for the aggregated age grouping at graduation.</li>
  <li>OLD_LABOUR_SUPPLY (Number): A legacy indicator for labor force entry used for comparison.</li>
  <li>WEIGHT_NLS (Number): A placeholder for specific weighting related to New Labour Supply.</li>
  <li>WEIGHT_OCC (Number): A placeholder for specific weighting related to occupational outcomes.</li>
  <li>WEIGHT_AGE (Number): A placeholder for specific weighting related to age distribution.</li>
  <li>NEW_LABOUR_SUPPLY_CIP_NOC (Number): A placeholder for labor supply indicators specifically mapped to CIP and NOC combinations.</li>
  <li>WEIGHT_NLS_CIP_NOC (Number): A placeholder for specific weights used in CIP-NOC labor supply analysis.</li>
  <li>WEIGHT_OCC_CIP_NOC (Number): A placeholder for weights used in CIP-NOC occupational analysis.</li>
  <li>ENDDT (Date): A placeholder for the record end date or survey completion date.</li>
</ul>

### t_dacso_data_part_1

<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>COCI_PEN (Number): The Personal Education Number (PEN) used to uniquely identify the student.</li>
  <li>COCI_STQU_ID (Number): The unique numeric identifier for the survey respondent.</li>
  <li>COCI_SUBM_CD (String): The submission code identifying the specific survey cycle (e.g. "C_Outc11").</li>
  <li>COCI_LRST_CD (String): The regional status code associated with the student's record.</li>
  <li>COCI_INST_CD (String): The administrative code for the post-secondary institution.</li>
  <li>PFST_CURRENT_ACTIVITY (Number): A code representing the student's primary activity at the time of the survey (e.g., working, studying).</li>
  <li>LCIP_LCIPPC_NAME (String): The name of the Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) cluster.</li>
  <li>LCIP_CD (String): The 2-digit CIP code family identifier.</li>
  <li>LCP4_CD (String): The 4-digit CIP code identifier for the specific program.</li>
  <li>CURRENT_REGION_PSSM_CODE (Number): The standardized PSSM regional code for the respondent's current residence.</li>
  <li>LCP4_CIP_4DIGITS_NAME (String): The descriptive name of the 4-digit CIP code program.</li>
  <li>TTRAIN (Number): A binary or numeric marker indicating if technical training was part of the program.</li>
  <li>TPID_LGND_CD (Number): A numeric gender identifier from administrative records.</li>
  <li>LABR_IN_LABOUR_MARKET (Number): A binary indicator (1/0) of whether the respondent is participating in the labor market.</li>
  <li>LABR_EMPLOYED (Number): A binary indicator (1/0) of whether the respondent is currently employed.</li>
  <li>LABR_UNEMPLOYED (Number): A binary indicator (1/0) of whether the respondent is currently unemployed.</li>
  <li>LABR_EMPLOYED_FULL_PART_TIME (Number): A code identifying employment status as either full-time or part-time.</li>
  <li>LABR_JOB_SEARCH_TIME_GP (Number): A numeric group code representing the duration of the student's job search.</li>
  <li>LABR_JOB_TRAINING_RELATED (Number): A binary marker indicating if the current job is related to the student's training.</li>
  <li>LABR_OCCUPATION_LNOC_CD (String): The National Occupational Classification (NOC) code for the respondent's current job.</li>
  <li>COCI_AGE_AT_SURVEY (Number): The respondent's age at the time they completed the survey.</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP (Number): The numeric bin identifier for the student's age cohort.</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP_ROLLUP (Number): A higher-level numeric code used for aggregated age reporting.</li>
  <li>COSC_GRAD_STATUS_LGDS_CD_GROUP (Number): A numeric group code classifying the student's graduation or completion status.</li>
  <li>RESPONDENT (Number): A flag indicating if the student successfully responded to the survey.</li>
  <li>NEW_LABOUR_SUPPLY (Number): A derived indicator representing the student's status as a new entry into the labor force.</li>
  <li>OLD_LABOUR_SUPPLY (Number): A legacy indicator for labor force entry (used for longitudinal comparison).</li>
  <li>WEIGHT (Number): The statistical weight assigned to the record for model-year analysis.</li>
  <li>HAD_PREVIOUS_CREDENTIAL (Number): A binary flag indicating if the student held a post-secondary credential prior to this program.</li>
  <li>PFST_IN_POST_SEC_BEFORE (Number): A binary flag indicating if the student had enrolled in post-secondary education previously.</li>
  <li>PFST_HAD_PREVIOUS_CDTL (Number): A raw indicator from the outcomes file regarding previous credentials held.</li>
  <li>PFST_FURSTDY_INCL_STILL_ATTD (Number): An indicator of whether the respondent is engaged in further study or still attending.</li>
  <li>PRGM_CREDENTIAL_AWARDED (String): The raw administrative code for the credential awarded to the student.</li>
  <li>PRGM_CREDENTIAL_AWARDED_NAME (String): The descriptive name of the specific credential awarded.</li>
  <li>PSSM_CREDENTIAL (String): The standardized credential code used for Provincial Student Survey Modeling.</li>
  <li>PSSM_CREDENTIAL_NAME (String): The full descriptive name of the PSSM-standardized credential.</li>
  <li>LCIP4_CRED (String): A composite analytical key combining graduation status, CIP-4 code, training, and credential.</li>
  <li>AGE_AT_GRAD (Number): The age of the student at the time of graduation.</li>
  <li>HAS_STP_CREDENTIAL (String): A flag indicating if the student has a specific STP credential.</li>
  <li>GRAD_STATUS_FACTORING_IN_STP (String): Derived variable representing the graduation status of the student, after accounting for the STP credential.</li>
</ul>

### trd_graduates

  <li>PSSM_CREDENTIAL (String): The standardized credential name used for provincial modeling and reporting.</li>
  <li>SUBM_CD (String): A character code representing the specific survey submission cycle (e.g. "C_Outc11").</li>
  <li>TRD_AGE_AT_SURVEY (Number): The age of the trades student at the time the survey was administered.</li>
  <li>EXPR1 (Number): A numeric value representing the graduate count for the specific cohort.</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP_LABEL (String): The standardized descriptive label for the age cohort (e.g., "20 to 24").</li>
</ul>

### appso_graduates

<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>SURVEY (String): A character code representing the specific student outcomes survey (e.g., "APPSO").</li>
  <li>PRIVATE (Number): A numeric flag or identifier indicating if the institution is a private provider.</li>
  <li>PSSM_CREDENTIAL (String): The standardized credential name used for provincial modeling.</li>
  <li>SUBM_CD (String): A character code representing the specific survey submission cycle (e.g. "C_Outc11").</li>
  <li>APP_AGE_AT_SURVEY (Number): The age of the apprentice at the time the survey was administered.</li>
  <li>EXPR1 (Number): A numeric value representing the graduate count for the specific cohort.</li>
  <li>AGE_GROUP (String): The standardized label assigned to the age cohort (e.g. "15 to 16").</li>
</ul>
